## Donor Metadata

a\) Read metadata and handle NA strings

```{r}

```

b\) mutate age col

```{r}
metadata_df |>
  mutate(age = map_dbl(.x = age, 
                   ~ str_split(.x, "[-+]",simplify = T) |>
                     # we look for ranges (-) or + (when more than 100y)
                     # and split into the two numbers
                     as.numeric() |> 
                     # we convert all values into numbers
                     mean(na.rm = T) |> 
                     # we take the mean. if there is only one val,
                     # or the other is NA (100+) => the single val is returned
                     floor() 
                     # in case the mean of a range returns a .5
                   )
         )
```

d-e) Add donor_id and structure acronym + Remove rnaseq id

```{r}
rnaseq_df <- rnaseq_df |> 
  inner_join(sample_df |>
               select(rnaseq_profile_id, donor_id, structure_acronym),
             by = join_by(sample_id == rnaseq_profile_id)) |>
  select(-sample_id)
```

f\) Place the two added col in first position

```{r}
rnaseq_df <- rnaseq_df |> 
  relocate(donor_id, structure_acronym)
```
